info.title: dbdeploy
info.description: dbdeploy is a cli tool to manage database migrations. It supports deployments, rollbacks, multiple branches, creation of databases. It works on Windows, Linux and Mac

options.name: --include
options.description: Glob(s) of scripts to format, relative to the path, for example "**/*.sql". Given one, every matching file is formatted instead of the deploy and rollback scripts of each branch, no database is contacted, and nothing is skipped. Separate several globs with spaces after the one flag: -i "**/*.sql" "setup/*.ddl". Only *, ** and ? are supported: a character class such as [Ii] matches nothing.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Glob(s) to leave out of --include, several separated by spaces after the one flag. Same syntax as --include, so write "_Init*" "_init*" rather than "_[Ii]nit*".

options.name: --provider
options.description: Dialect to format with when it cannot be told from the folder layout, for example sqlServer, oracle, mySql or postgreSql.
